newsitem.title: USA: Diametrics in talks to buy Pfizer unit.
newsitem.headline: Diametrics in talks to buy Pfizer unit.

text.p: Diametrics Medical Inc said Wednesday it is negotiating the purchase of Biomedical Sensors Ltd, an operating unit of Pfizer Inc, for an undisclosed amount.
Biomedical Sensors, based in High Wycombe, England, has developed monitoring systems for continuous blood and tissue assessment of critically ill patients.
Biomedical Sensors is expected to operate as a subsidiary of Diametrics once the purchase is concluded. Roy Johnson will continue serving as Biomedical Sensors president.

"The acquisition of BSL is a major step forward in fulfilling Diametric's strategic intent to be the world leader in Critical Care Blood Analysis Systems," said David Giddings, Diametrics chairman and president, in a statement.
The acquisition will add significant new products to Diametrics' line of critical care blood analysis and monitoring products, he said.
Shares of Diametrics Medical were trading unchanged at 4-3/4.
